title: PS 5 and living with his aunt
summary: He recalls the school at 141st Street and the several apartments they moved between, with his aunt as a foster mother.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

Where?
It's 141st and Edgecombe Avenue.
Uh huh.
Between 140th, 141st and Edgecombe Avenue.
Yeah. Yeah. So, you had a way to go?
Yeah. Yeah.

Mm hmm.
